Description
Beautifully updated, unfurnished 2-story townhouse-style condo in sought-after Kitsilano. This bright, south-facing home features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a spacious laundry room and ample storage. Modern kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, gas stove and plenty of cabinetry. Open-concept living and dining area with a cozy gas fireplace. Enjoy a private, south-facing fenced yard and patio, perfect for outdoor dining and relaxing. Building amenities include a children's playroom, bike room and workshop. Steps to transit and close to UBC, Downtown, Bayview Elementary, parks, shops, cafes and restaurants.

Description
Welcome to luxury penthouse living at 2102 W 48th Ave, Unit #508, nestled in Vancouver’s prestigious Kerrisdale. This expansive corner home features 2 beautifully designed bedrooms, a versatile den, and 3.5 bathrooms, available fully, partially, or unfurnished. The crown jewel is a 3,500 sq ft private rooftop deck with a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, dedicated washroom, and panoramic views. Exceptional utility includes 4 parking spaces (2 in a private garage) and a 400 sq ft storage room. Steps away, enjoy Kerrisdale Village cafes, top schools like Magee and Point Grey, the Arbutus Greenway, and direct transit to UBC, Oakridge, and Downtown Vancouver. If viewing on Zillow please text or email the leasing agent.

Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Description
Experience refined West Coast living in this custom Brandes luxury home, tucked in Point Grey’s coveted North of 4th. A reverse floor plan maximizes water views from the open-concept main floor featuring 11'+ vaulted ceilings. A private elevator connects all three levels, leading to a chef’s kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, custom millwork, a wine cellar, and a private theater. Relax on the rooftop deck with a hot tub and panoramic ocean, mountain, and city views. Finished with stone, marble, and full home automation, this 4-bed, 5-bath unfurnished residence blends warmth and modern luxury steps from Spanish Banks, Jericho Beach, UBC, and top schools like Lord Byng. If viewing on Zillow please text or email the leasing agent.
